cohort_ledger.individualization_policy: Three standing-role cohorts only; person-lite internal commanders are reclassified conserved bodies and never extra manpower.

geographic_disposition.rule: private force remains separate exact owner; home/deployment does not transfer ownership

infrastructure.support_scope: House Tang unified field army, Sword Manor, and Four Bastion Corps logistics

officer_establishment.internal_loadout_rule: Army and major-unit commanders/deputies use loadout_house_champion. Embedded 1,000/500 commanders use their troop loadout: House Guard infantry uses loadout_house_guard; Guardian Cavalry and Tang Champions use loadout_house_champion.
officer_establishment.representation_rule: 1,000/500 commanders are materialized from conserved fighting bodies; ordinary 100-man and below commanders remain aggregate unless salient. Army and unit commander/deputy bodies are outside fighting strength.

personnel_representation: cohort-first; internal 1,000/500 commanders materialize conserved fighting bodies; army/unit commanders and deputies are command-establishment people outside fighting strength; 100-man and below command remains aggregate unless salient.
